mapper.select: select i.invoice_id, i.invoice_no, i.order_id, i.applicant_id, i.invoice_type, i.email, i.title, i.tax_no, i.amount, i.invoice_url, i.status, i.reject_reason, i.invoice_time, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.remark, o.order_no, w.title as work_title from sys_invoice i left join sys_order o on i.order_id = o.order_id left join sys_work w on o.work_id = w.work_id where i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_invoice ( invoice_no, order_id, applicant_id, invoice_type, email, title, tax_no, amount, status, created_at ) values ( #{invoiceNo}, #{orderId}, #{applicantId}, #{invoiceType}, #{email}, #{title}, #{taxNo}, #{amount}, 'pending', NOW() )
